sentences.japanese: 程なくして、月が顔を出した。
sentences.english: Before long, the moon came out.

sentences.japanese: 料理人は彼の信じられない程の食欲にとても驚いた。
sentences.english: The cook was astonished at his incredible appetite.

sentences.japanese: この話は又聞きなので、真偽の程は分かりません。
sentences.english: As I heard the story secondhand, I can't ascertain the truth of it.
